Oxford Insights Government AI Readiness Index

indicators.name: 정부 AI 준비도 지수 (종합)
indicators.name_en: Government AI Readiness Index: total score
indicators.definition: Overall score (0-100) of the Oxford Insights Government AI Readiness Index, which assesses how ready governments are to implement AI in the delivery of public services. The 2025 edition examines 69 indicators across 14 dimensions within six pillars: Policy Capacity, Governance, AI Infrastructure, Public Sector Adoption, Development & Diffusion and Resilience.

indicators.name: 인터넷 이용자 비율
indicators.name_en: Individuals using the Internet (% of population)
indicators.definition: Internet users are individuals who have used the Internet (from any location) in the last 3 months. The Internet can be used via a computer, mobile phone, personal digital assistant, games machine, digital TV etc.

indicators.name: 이동통신 가입 건수
indicators.name_en: Mobile cellular subscriptions (per 100 people)
indicators.definition: Mobile cellular telephone subscriptions are subscriptions to a public mobile telephone service that provide access to the PSTN using cellular technology. The indicator includes (and is split into) the number of postpaid subscriptions, and the number of active prepaid accounts (i.e. that have been used during the last three months). The indicator applies to all mobile cellular subscriptions that offer voice communications. It excludes subscriptions via data cards or USB modems, subscriptions to public mobile data services, private trunked mobile radio, telepoint, radio paging and telemetry services.

indicators.name: 유선 초고속인터넷 가입 건수
indicators.name_en: Fixed broadband subscriptions (per 100 people)
indicators.definition: Fixed broadband subscriptions refers to fixed subscriptions to high-speed access to the public Internet (a TCP/IP connection), at downstream speeds equal to, or greater than, 256 kbit/s. This includes cable modem, DSL, fiber-to-the-home/building, other fixed (wired)-broadband subscriptions, satellite broadband and terrestrial fixed wireless broadband. This total is measured irrespective of the method of payment. It excludes subscriptions that have access to data communications (including the Internet) via mobile-cellular networks. It should include fixed WiMAX and any other fixed wireless technologies. It includes both residential subscriptions and subscriptions for organizations.

indicators.name: 전력 접근률
indicators.name_en: Access to electricity (% of population)
indicators.definition: Access to electricity is the percentage of population with access to electricity. Electrification data are collected from industry, national surveys and international sources.

indicators.name: 금융계좌 보유율
indicators.name_en: Account ownership at a financial institution or with a mobile-money-service provider (% of population ages 15+)
indicators.definition: Account denotes the percentage of respondents who report having an account (by themselves or together with someone else) at a bank or another type of financial institution or report personally using a mobile money service in the past 12 months (% age 15+).

indicators.name: 금융계좌 보유율 (여성)
indicators.name_en: Account ownership at a financial institution or with a mobile-money-service provider, female (% of population ages 15+)
indicators.definition: Account denotes the percentage of respondents who report having an account (by themselves or together with someone else) at a bank or another type of financial institution or report personally using a mobile money service in the past 12 months (female, % age 15+).

indicators.name: 금융계좌 보유율 (남성)
indicators.name_en: Account ownership at a financial institution or with a mobile-money-service provider, male (% of population ages 15+)
indicators.definition: Account denotes the percentage of respondents who report having an account (by themselves or together with someone else) at a bank or another type of financial institution or report personally using a mobile money service in the past 12 months (male, % age 15+).

indicators.name: 금융계좌 보유율 (소득 하위 40%)
indicators.name_en: Account ownership at a financial institution or with a mobile-money-service provider, poorest 40% (% of population ages 15+)
indicators.definition: Account denotes the percentage of respondents who report having an account (by themselves or together with someone else) at a bank or another type of financial institution or report personally using a mobile money service in the past 12 months (poorest 40%, share of population ages 15+).

indicators.name: 금융계좌 보유율 (소득 상위 60%)
indicators.name_en: Account ownership at a financial institution or with a mobile-money-service provider, richest 60% (% of population ages 15+)
indicators.definition: Account denotes the percentage of respondents who report having an account (by themselves or together with someone else) at a bank or another type of financial institution or report personally using a mobile money service in the past 12 months (richest 60%, share of population ages 15+).

indicators.name: 금융계좌 보유율 (초등교육 이하)
indicators.name_en: Account ownership at a financial institution or with a mobile-money-service provider, primary education or less (% of population ages 15+)
indicators.definition: Account denotes the percentage of respondents who report having an account (by themselves or together with someone else) at a bank or another type of financial institution or report personally using a mobile money service in the past 12 months (primary education or less, % of population ages 15+).

indicators.name: 금융계좌 보유율 (중등교육 이상)
indicators.name_en: Account ownership at a financial institution or with a mobile-money-service provider, secondary education or more (% of population ages 15+)
indicators.definition: Account denotes the percentage of respondents who report having an account (by themselves or together with someone else) at a bank or another type of financial institution or report personally using a mobile money service in the past 12 months (secondary education or more, % of population ages 15+).

indicators.name: ICT 발전지수 (IDI 종합)
indicators.name_en: ICT Development Index (IDI) score
indicators.definition: Composite index (0-100) published by ITU measuring universal and meaningful connectivity. It combines 10 indicators organized in two pillars of equal weight: Universal connectivity and Meaningful connectivity. New methodology since the 2023 edition; the year is the edition year and indicator values generally refer to two years earlier.

indicators.name: IDI: 의미 있는 연결성
indicators.name_en: IDI Meaningful connectivity pillar score
indicators.definition: Pillar score (0-100) of the ITU ICT Development Index: average of normalized scores for 3G and 4G/LTE network coverage, mobile- and fixed-broadband Internet traffic per subscription, mobile data and voice and fixed-broadband basket prices, and individuals owning a mobile phone.

indicators.name: IDI: 보편적 연결성
indicators.name_en: IDI Universal connectivity pillar score
indicators.definition: Pillar score (0-100) of the ITU ICT Development Index: average of normalized scores for individuals using the Internet, households with Internet access at home, and active mobile-broadband subscriptions per 100 inhabitants.

indicators.name: 3G 커버리지 인구 비율
indicators.name_en: Population covered by at least a 3G mobile network (%)
indicators.definition: Percentage of the population covered by at least a 3G mobile network refers to the percentage of inhabitants that are within range of at least a 3G mobile-cellular signal, irrespective of whether or not they are subscribers. This is calculated by dividing the number of inhabitants that are covered by at least a 3G mobile-cellular signal by the total population and multiplying by 100.

indicators.name: 4G/LTE 커버리지 인구 비율
indicators.name_en: Population covered by at least a 4G/LTE mobile network (%)
indicators.definition: Percentage of the population covered by at least a 4G/LTE mobile network refers to the percentage of inhabitants that live within range of LTE/LTE-Advanced, mobile WiMAX/WirelessMAN or other more advanced mobile-cellular networks, irrespective of whether or not they are subscribers. This is calculated by dividing the number of inhabitants that are covered by the previously mentioned mobile-cellular technologies by the total population and multiplying by 100. It excludes people covered only by HSPA, UMTS, EV-DO and previous 3G technologies, and also excludes fixed WiMAX coverage.

indicators.name: 5G 커버리지 인구 비율
indicators.name_en: Population covered by at least a 5G mobile network (%)
indicators.definition: Percentage of inhabitants that are within range of at least a 5G mobile-cellular signal, irrespective of whether or not they are subscribers (ITU series i271G5_pop).

indicators.name: 가정 내 인터넷 접속 가구 비율
indicators.name_en: Households with Internet access at home (%)
indicators.definition: Proportion of households with Internet access at home. Internet access at home means that the Internet is generally available for use by all members of the household at any time, regardless of whether it is actually used. The connection and devices may or may not be owned by the household but should be considered household assets. If one member of the household has a mobile phone with connection to the Internet and makes it available for all members, then it should be considered that the household has access to the Internet. An Internet connection in the household should be working at the time of the survey.

indicators.name: 모바일 브로드밴드 가입 건수
indicators.name_en: Active mobile-broadband subscriptions per 100 inhabitants
indicators.definition: Active mobile-broadband subscriptions per 100 inhabitants. Active mobile-broadband subscriptions refers to the sum of standard mobile-broadband and dedicated mobile-broadband subscriptions to the public Internet. It covers actual subscribers, not potential subscribers, even though the latter may have broadband enabled-handsets. Subscriptions must include a recurring subscription fee or if in the prepayment modality, pass a usage requirement – users must have accessed the Internet in the last three months.

indicators.name: 휴대전화 보유율
indicators.name_en: Individuals owning a mobile phone (%)
indicators.definition: Proportion of individuals who own a mobile phone. An individual owns a mobile cellular phone if he/she has a mobile cellular phone device with at least one active SIM card for personal use. It includes mobile cellular phones supplied by employers that can be used for personal reasons (to make personal calls, access the Internet, etc.) and those who have a mobile phone for personal use that is not registered under his/her name. It excludes individuals who have only active SIM card(s) and not a mobile phone device.

indicators.name: 휴대전화 보유율 (여성)
indicators.name_en: Individuals owning a mobile phone, female (%)
indicators.definition: Proportion of individuals who own a mobile phone. An individual owns a mobile cellular phone if he/she has a mobile cellular phone device with at least one active SIM card for personal use. It includes mobile cellular phones supplied by employers that can be used for personal reasons (to make personal calls, access the Internet, etc.) and those who have a mobile phone for personal use that is not registered under his/her name. It excludes individuals who have only active SIM card(s) and not a mobile phone device. Female population only.

indicators.name: 휴대전화 보유율 (남성)
indicators.name_en: Individuals owning a mobile phone, male (%)
indicators.definition: Proportion of individuals who own a mobile phone. An individual owns a mobile cellular phone if he/she has a mobile cellular phone device with at least one active SIM card for personal use. It includes mobile cellular phones supplied by employers that can be used for personal reasons (to make personal calls, access the Internet, etc.) and those who have a mobile phone for personal use that is not registered under his/her name. It excludes individuals who have only active SIM card(s) and not a mobile phone device. Male population only.

indicators.name: 유선 브로드밴드 요금 부담 (5GB)
indicators.name_en: Fixed-broadband Internet basket price (% of GNI per capita)
indicators.definition: Entry-level fixed-broadband basket price as percentage of GNI per capita. The basket is composed of the cheapest plan providing at least 5GB of monthly high-speed data (256Kbit/s or higher) from the operator with the largest market share in each economy. See ITU ICT price statistics website for detailed data collection rules.

indicators.name: 모바일 데이터·음성 요금 부담 (고사용량: 140분·70건·2GB)
indicators.name_en: Mobile data and voice high-consumption basket price (% of GNI per capita)
indicators.definition: Mobile-broadband data and voice high-consumption basket price as a percentage of GNI per capita (p.c.). The basket refers to the cheapest mobile broadband plan (and add-on) providing at least 2 GB of monthly data using at least 3G technology, 140 minutes of voice and 70 SMSs. See ITU ICT price statistics website for detailed data collection rules.

indicators.name: 모바일 데이터 전용 요금 부담 (2GB)
indicators.name_en: Data-only mobile-broadband basket price, 2 GB (% of GNI per capita)
indicators.definition: Price of the cheapest data-only mobile-broadband plan providing at least 2 GB of monthly data, as a percentage of GNI per capita. See the ITU ICT price statistics website for detailed data collection rules (ITU series i271mb_2GB_GNI).

indicators.name: 금융계좌 보유율 성별 격차 (남성−여성)
indicators.name_en: Account ownership gender gap (male minus female, percentage points)
indicators.definition: Calculated by the Institute of African Studies, Yonsei University: 'Account ownership at a financial institution or with a mobile-money-service provider, male (% of population ages 15+)' minus 'Account ownership at a financial institution or with a mobile-money-service provider, female (% of population ages 15+)' for the same country and year (percentage points). Positive values mean the first group is higher.

indicators.name: 금융계좌 보유율 소득 격차 (상위 60%−하위 40%)
indicators.name_en: Account ownership income gap (richest 60% minus poorest 40%, percentage points)
indicators.definition: Calculated by the Institute of African Studies, Yonsei University: 'Account ownership at a financial institution or with a mobile-money-service provider, richest 60% (% of population ages 15+)' minus 'Account ownership at a financial institution or with a mobile-money-service provider, poorest 40% (% of population ages 15+)' for the same country and year (percentage points). Positive values mean the first group is higher.

indicators.name: 금융계좌 보유율 교육 격차 (중등 이상−초등 이하)
indicators.name_en: Account ownership education gap (secondary or more minus primary or less, percentage points)
indicators.definition: Calculated by the Institute of African Studies, Yonsei University: 'Account ownership at a financial institution or with a mobile-money-service provider, secondary education or more (% of population ages 15+)' minus 'Account ownership at a financial institution or with a mobile-money-service provider, primary education or less (% of population ages 15+)' for the same country and year (percentage points). Positive values mean the first group is higher.

indicators.name: 4G 커버리지 대비 미이용 격차 (4G 커버리지−인터넷 이용률)
indicators.name_en: Usage gap: 4G/LTE population coverage minus Internet use (percentage points)
indicators.definition: Calculated by the Institute of African Studies, Yonsei University: 'Population covered by at least a 4G/LTE mobile network (%)' minus 'Individuals using the Internet (% of population)' for the same country and year (percentage points). Positive values mean the first group is higher.

indicators.name: 휴대전화 보유율 성별 격차 (남성−여성)
indicators.name_en: Mobile phone ownership gender gap (male minus female, percentage points)
indicators.definition: Calculated by the Institute of African Studies, Yonsei University: 'Individuals owning a mobile phone, male (%)' minus 'Individuals owning a mobile phone, female (%)' for the same country and year (percentage points). Positive values mean the first group is higher.

indicators.name: 고등교육 총취학률
indicators.name_en: School enrollment, tertiary (% gross)
indicators.definition: Gross enrollment ratio is the ratio of total enrollment, regardless of age, to the population of the age group that officially corresponds to the level of education shown. Tertiary education, whether or not to an advanced research qualification, normally requires, as a minimum condition of admission, the successful completion of education at the secondary level.

indicators.name: R&D 지출
indicators.name_en: Research and development expenditure (% of GDP)
indicators.definition: Gross domestic expenditures on research and development (R&D), expressed as a percent of GDP. They include both capital and current expenditures in the four main sectors: Business enterprise, Government, Higher education and Private non-profit. R&D covers basic research, applied research, and experimental development.

indicators.name: 보안 인터넷 서버 수
indicators.name_en: Secure Internet servers (per 1 million people)
indicators.definition: The number of distinct, publicly-trusted TLS/SSL certificates found in the Netcraft Secure Server Survey (by hosting country), per 1 million people.

indicators.name: ICT 서비스 수출 비중
indicators.name_en: ICT service exports (% of service exports, BoP)
indicators.definition: Information and communication technology service exports include computer and communications services (telecommunications and postal and courier services) and information services (computer data and news-related service transactions).
